name: sub-guillotine
description: Autonomous financial defense agent that hunts recurring subscriptions, bypasses deceptive dark patterns via Playwright, and enforces human-in-the-loop approval before executing cancellations.

tools.name: extract_subscription_from_email
tools.description: Extracts structured subscription details from raw email text or HTML via Amazon Bedrock Converse API.

tools.name: check_imminent_deadlines
tools.description: Scans the SQLite ledger for subscriptions renewing within the configurable threshold (default 24h).

tools.name: stage_cancellation
tools.description: Navigates headless Playwright Chromium through multi-step dark pattern funnels up to final confirmation.

tools.name: dispatch_hitl_decision
tools.description: Enforces human approval gate via Rich terminal prompt or Telegram bot push notification with visual screenshot proof.

tools.name: commit_cancellation
tools.description: Clicks final confirm cancellation in browser, captures receipt screenshot, and archives savings in SQLite ledger.
